note: Standing offers and loyalty programs that are widely available in each chain's app. Exact terms change often; the app links you to the live offers page. Local coupons (mailers, receipts) can be saved in the app.

deals.title: Free Fries Friday
deals.detail: Free medium fries with any $1+ purchase every Friday in the McDonald's app.

deals.title: $5 Meal Deal
deals.detail: McDouble or McChicken + small fries + 4 pc McNuggets + small drink. 4 pc nuggets + McChicken combo runs ~800 kcal; swap the drink for Diet Coke and skip fries to land near 570.

deals.title: App deals tab
deals.detail: Rotating 20-30% off and BOGO offers (e.g. 20% off any $10+ order, $2 large fries, free McChicken with $2 purchase). Refreshes weekly.

deals.title: Under $3 Menu
deals.detail: 10+ McValue items under $3 all day, including McChicken, McDouble, 4 pc McNuggets, small fries and a medium soft drink, plus breakfast items like the Sausage McMuffin, Sausage Burrito and hash browns.

deals.title: $4 Breakfast Meal Deal
deals.detail: Sausage McMuffin or Sausage Biscuit with hash browns and a small coffee for $4.

deals.title: Royal Perks
deals.detail: Earn 10 crowns per $1; redeem for items (Whopper Jr. is a cheap redemption). Birthday reward.

deals.title: $5 Your Way Meal
deals.detail: Whopper Jr. + 4 pc nuggets + value fries + value drink. Order the drink diet and it's ~700 kcal.

deals.title: App offers
deals.detail: Weekly rotating coupons (e.g. $3 Whopper, BOGO Original Chicken Sandwich). Check the Offers tab.

deals.title: Frosty Key Tag
deals.detail: $3 key tag (sold Nov-Jan) gets a free Jr. Frosty with any purchase all year. Jr. Frosty is 200 kcal.

deals.title: App offers
deals.detail: Rotating offers like free 10 pc nuggets with purchase, $2 off Dave's Single, or free small fries with mobile order.

deals.title: Biggie Deals ($4 / $6 / $8)
deals.detail: $4 Biggie Bites (two small items), $6 Biggie Bag (Jr. Cheeseburger, Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger, Double Stack or Crispy Chicken Sandwich + 4 pc nuggets + Jr. fries + small drink), or $8 Biggie Bundle (two sandwiches + Jr. fries + small drink).

deals.title: Luxe Cravings Box ($7)
deals.detail: Chalupa Supreme + Beefy 5-Layer Burrito + Doritos Locos Taco + Cinnamon Twists + drink. About 1,300 kcal for the whole box; save half.

deals.title: Taco Tuesday app deals
deals.detail: Discounted tacos most Tuesdays in the app. Crunchy Taco is 170 kcal.

deals.title: Taco Bell Rewards
deals.detail: 10 points per $1, free item at 250. Birthday reward and rotating challenges.

deals.title: Luxe Value Menu ($3 or less)
deals.detail: Ten items at $3 or less nationally, including the Cheesy Bean & Rice Burrito, Spicy Potato Soft Taco, Cheesy Roll Up, Mini Taco Salad and Beefy Potato Loaded Griller.

deals.title: Chick-fil-A One
deals.detail: 10 points per $1 on the base tier. Frequent free-item offers (usually a sandwich or nuggets) pushed via the app.

deals.title: Kids' Meal reward
deals.detail: Kids' Meal toy can be traded for a small Icedream cone in restaurant.

deals.title: BOGO / Footlong codes
deals.detail: Recurring codes in the app and by email: BOGO 50% off, $6.99 footlongs, or free cookie with sub. Apply at checkout in the app.

deals.title: Subway MVP Rewards
deals.detail: Earn points on every order; free cookies, chips and subs at tier thresholds.

deals.title: Fresh Value Menu
deals.detail: Permanent national value menu: $3.99 six-inch Deli Faves (Cold Cut Combo, B.L.T., Spicy Pepperoni, Ham & Salami), $3.99 Protein Pockets, and a $4.99 six-inch Sub of the Day.

deals.title: BOGO event codes
deals.detail: Sports-tied BOGO codes (e.g. after hockey/basketball games in your market) and National Burrito Day offers.

deals.title: Chipotle Rewards
deals.detail: 10 points per $1; 815 points for 50% off an entree or 1,625 for a free entree, plus monthly Freepotle bonus drops, a birthday reward, and free chips & guac after joining.

deals.title: Popeyes Rewards
deals.detail: 10 points per $1 in the app. Free 3 pc tenders or side at redemption tiers.

deals.title: KFC Rewards
deals.detail: 10 points per $1; frequent 'Taste of KFC' $5-$6 deals and free-side offers for members.

deals.title: $5 / $6 meal boxes
deals.detail: Rotating boxes (2 pc chicken or tenders + side + biscuit). Original Recipe drumsticks + green beans keeps it near 400 kcal.

deals.title: 2 for $7 Classic Roast Beef
deals.detail: Long-running offer: two Classic Roast Beef for $7. Each is 360 kcal / 23 g protein, so share with your partner.

deals.title: Arby's Deals email + app
deals.detail: Weekly emailed coupons (free small fries with sandwich, $2 off $10). Sign up in the app.

deals.title: Meat & 3 Value Box
deals.detail: $7.99 box with a Classic Roast Beef or Crispy Chicken sandwich, small fries, 2 mozzarella sticks, a peach cobbler roll and a small drink ($9.99 French Dip & Swiss version).

deals.title: Half-price drinks & slushes in the app
deals.detail: Order ahead in the app for 50% off drinks and slushes, all day. Diet Cherry Limeade is 15 kcal.

deals.title: Happy Hour (2-4 pm)
deals.detail: Half-price drinks at the drive-in during Happy Hour in most markets.

deals.title: $1.99 Menu
deals.detail: Permanent value menu with rotating items, currently the Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger, Cheesy Baja Crispy Tender Wrap, Vanilla Soft Serve Cup and Small Root Beer Float for $1.99 each.

deals.title: Jack Pack rewards
deals.detail: Earn points in the app; two tacos for 99c and free curly fries offers are common.

deals.title: MyCulver's
deals.detail: App offers like free scoop with purchase and BOGO ButterBurgers; Flavor of the Day alerts.

deals.title: Delicious Rewards
deals.detail: Earn 10 points per $1 on direct orders. Redeem 500 points for a scoop or medium fries, 750 for a ButterBurger or medium curds, or 1,000 for a medium Concrete Mixer or tenders. New members get 25% off their first order, plus birthday and half-birthday treats.

deals.title: Panda Rewards
deals.detail: 10 points per $1; frequent 'free bowl' and 'family meal $5 off' offers. Bowl (1 entree + 1 side) is the cheapest way to order.

deals.title: Dunkin' Rewards
deals.detail: 10 points per $1, boosted status after 12 visits/month. $3 medium latte and free donut with drink offers rotate weekly.

deals.title: $6 Meal Deal
deals.detail: Bacon, Egg & Cheese Sandwich, hash browns and a medium hot or iced coffee for $6.

deals.title: Whataburger Rewards
deals.detail: Earn on every visit; 5-visit rewards and a free item on your birthday. App-only offers rotate.

deals.title: More for $4 Menu
deals.detail: Bacon & Cheese Whataburger Jr., Patty Melt Jr., Honey BBQ or Buffalo Ranch Chicken Strip Sandwich Jr. for $4 each, plus small fries and a drink for $3 more. Launched Aug 18, 2026 with no end date, at participating locations.

deals.title: Free Whataburger for new app accounts
deals.detail: Create a Whataburger app account to get a free Whataburger and start earning points toward menu items.

deals.title: DQ Rewards
deals.detail: App-only deals like $1 small cones and BOGO Blizzards on Tuesdays in many markets.

deals.title: No coupons
deals.detail: In-N-Out doesn't run coupons or an app. Prices are already among the lowest; a Protein Style Hamburger is $3.75.

deals.title: No coupons
deals.detail: Five Guys rarely discounts. Best value: split a Little fries (530 kcal) between two people.

deals.title: Lunch Specials
deals.detail: Monday–Friday 11 AM–2 PM: pick a special (5 pc wing basket, 4 or 6 pc tender basket, buffalo chicken sandwich, grilled chicken breast, fish tacos, half-pound burger, or a salad) with tea or a fountain drink included. Coupons and discount cards don't apply to specials.

deals.title: Offers in the Chicken Express app
deals.detail: Chicken Express runs its offers and online ordering through its app. Check it for current deals at your store.

deals.title: Freebirds Rewards
deals.detail: Earn 1 point for every $1 spent on qualifying purchases and unlock member offers and rewards in the Freebirds app.

deals.title: Caniac Club
deals.detail: Free loyalty card/app club with a birthday free drink, membership-anniversary food reward (often BOGO Box Combo) and occasional seasonal offers; no sign-up freebie since Aug 2024.

deals.title: Club Wingstop
deals.detail: Wingstop's points-based loyalty program (launched June 2026) with food rewards, points sharing, group ordering and early access to new flavors via the app.

deals.title: Starbucks Rewards
deals.detail: Tiered program since Mar 2026: Green earns 1 Star/$1 (Gold 1.2, Reserve 1.7); redeem 25 Stars for $1 off, 100 for up to $6 off brewed coffee/bakery, 200 for up to $10 off a handcrafted drink or hot breakfast; one free drink modification on a Monday each month.
deals.recurring: Free Mod Monday once a month

deals.title: MyPanera
deals.detail: Free rewards program with personalized offers (e.g., free bagel, $ off a salad) earned through visits.

deals.title: MyPanera+ Sip Club
deals.detail: $14.99/mo or $119.99/yr subscription for self-serve coffee, tea, fountain drinks and lemonade, one every 2 hours, capped at 30 drinks per billing cycle since Aug 19, 2026.
